title: V22.2 — Deep scan + chunk visibility tab (editor-only) + opaque/soft paint modes

user_request.raw: Daha derin tara; editörde haritayı ayarlarken tüm terrain açık olunca kasıyor → chunk görünürlük aç/kapa (sadece editör, sadece toggle açtıklarım gözüksün, yeni sekmeye); boyama berbat — basılı tuttuğum kadar şeffaf boyuyor → şeffaf boyama AYRI özellik olsun (geçişler için), normal boyama dolgu olsun; JSON plan + task üret, AAA; baştan kötüyse daha geliştir.
interpreted: F1: Editor-only chunk visibility manager — whitelist model (only toggled-on chunks render & mesh), new tab in plugin panel, bulk ops, persists in scene, runtime untouched.
F2: Paint modes — FILL (default: one pass = full coverage, mask/falloff shapes the edge) and SOFT (current gradual transparent build-up, kept as explicit transition tool).
F3: Deeper audit pass — cover fix_texture_imports.gd (only unread file), cursor/transform correctness, cross-module wiring; fix verified defects only.
F4: Architecture — new UI goes into editor/ui/ module (not into the 2.3K-line plugin god-class); systems stay testable headless.

architecture_decisions.ADR-020-1: Chunk visibility state lives ON the node (@export enabled flag + Array[Vector2i] whitelist — a few hundred bytes in .tscn) because it must survive reloads and drive chunk lifecycle; UI lives in editor/ui/chunk_visibility_tab.gd (new file) so plugin.gd does not grow another panel inline.
architecture_decisions.ADR-020-2: Hidden chunks are not just .visible=false: their mesh is set to null (ArrayMesh freed) and meshing is SKIPPED (update_chunk_mesh early-out → stale set). This converts the user's lag (full-map meshing during map adjustments) into near-zero cost; re-showing queues a budgeted rebuild from height_data.
architecture_decisions.ADR-020-3: Editor-only gating happens at the EFFECTIVE check (Engine.is_editor_hint() or _force_chunk_visibility test hook), so an exported game always renders everything even if the scene saved enabled=true.
architecture_decisions.ADR-020-4: Paint opacity is a SplatmapSystem parameter (opaque: bool, default false) — pure, headless-testable; node holds paint_mode (FILL default — the user calls the old behaviour 'berbat', so the good mode must be the default); strength slider is disabled+tooltipped in FILL (falloff alone shapes the dab).
architecture_decisions.ADR-020-5: bake_collision temporarily disables visibility mode (setter round-trip) so collision always bakes ALL chunks at full res — runtime collision must not depend on editor visibility.
